events.context: Demerzel commit a42b19a — 'The Sentinel — governed reactive reasoner spec v1.0'. New persona/agent class: a reactive reasoner that watches harness signals and triggers governance responses. Spec-only — no behavioral test, no consumer wired yet. State: U (Unknown) until first concrete invocation.

The Sentinel needs: (1) behavioral test in tests/behavioral/the-sentinel-cases.md, (2) schema conformance check against schemas/persona.schema.json, (3) at least one consumer wiring (likely ix sentrux peer or hari swarm bridge). Per CLAUDE.md persona-requirements rule, missing test blocks effectiveness assessment.

Correction, 2026-09-13. The first measured citation count (scripts/evolution_metrics.py, #1077) is 0, which reads as 'nothing uses this spec'. That is true only inside Demerzel: the metric cannot see sibling repositories. ix crates/ix-sentinel implements the spec and cites demerzel/docs/governance/the-sentinel.md in its module doc and help text. Its MVP (ix 976b825) landed on 2026-04-12, the same day as the spec, so the 2026-04-30 gap 'no consumer wiring' was already wrong when written. What remains true: the crate has no tests and has not changed since 2026-04-26, and there is no tests/behavioral/the-sentinel-cases.md.

effectiveness.proposition: The spec has a consumer in ix (crates/ix-sentinel), untested and untouched since 2026-04-26, and no Demerzel behavioral test. State stays U until the consumer runs under test and provides evidence.
